posts.title: Building an NFC Music Box
posts.description: My son and I built an NFC-based music player so he can play the music he wants, develop his own musical taste but most of all so that he and I could have something fun to build together. Kind of like a modern day record player, but infinitely more extensible, and with each album costing 1/100th the price of a vinyl record. posts.title: Evaluating SwiftSyntax for use in SwiftLint
posts.description: tl;dr; Implementing SwiftLint using SwiftSyntax instead of SourceKitten would make it run over 20x slower 😭 Update: Since writing this post, I learnt that SwiftSyntax’s upcoming byte tree deserialization mode will speed this up considerably. I hope to post a follow-up article on this shortly. I have for some time been looking forward to reimplementing some of SwiftLint ’s simpler syntax-only rules
